summary: API changes from 2.4 to 2.5 and 2.6: browsable APIs at /api/gateway/v1, /api/controller/v2 and /api/eda/v1; controller endpoints moved from /api/v2/ to /api/controller/v2/, hub from /api/automation-hub to /api/galaxy/v1, and token authentication from /api/v2/o to /api/gateway/v1/tokens/.
questions: What is the controller API path in AAP 2.6?
How do I create an API token in AAP 2.6?
What is the automation hub API path in AAP 2.6?

answer_card.title: API paths in AAP 2.5 and 2.6
answer_card.answer_md:
| Component | 2.4 | 2.5 and later |
|---|---|---|
| Controller | `/api/v2/` | `/api/controller/v2/` |
| Automation hub | `/api/automation-hub` | `/api/galaxy/v1` |
| Platform gateway | n/a | `/api/gateway/v1/` |
| Event-Driven Ansible | n/a | `/api/eda/v1/` |

Tokens moved from `/api/v2/o` to `/api/gateway/v1/tokens/`.
